title: Pasta Primavera
description: A bright spring pasta with asparagus, peas, zucchini and cherry tomatoes in a light lemon, garlic and Parmesan sauce.

image.alt: A plate of pasta with peas, asparagus, zucchini and tomatoes

ingredients.item: short pasta such as farfalle or penne

ingredients.prep: trimmed and cut into {len 1 in} pieces

steps.text: Cook the pasta in a big pot of salted boiling water. Add the asparagus and peas for the last {time 2 min notimer}. Save {qty 1 cup fixed} of the water, then drain everything together.
Meanwhile heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat and cook the zucchini until lightly browned, {time 4 min}. Add the garlic for {time 1 min}.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until they start to soften, {time 2 min}.
Add the pasta and vegetables, butter, lemon zest and juice, salt, cheese and a splash of pasta water and toss until glossy. Scatter with basil and serve.

notes: Use whatever green vegetables are in season: broccoli, green beans or snap peas all work.
